legacy.asofRule: TargetDate > RunDate; anchor is the latest recorded close on or before RunDate
limitations: Covers recorded yhat_adj only; it does not validate the current ensemble or terrain decision chain.
Overlapping weekly horizons are dependent observations and must not be treated as independent trials.
Historical rows do not carry parameter or code version identifiers.
RunDate has date precision only; the exact issuance time and historical source-data cutoff were not recorded.
